title: Chrome Dino Game
description:
Pixel dinosaur runner for BMW iDrive 7/8.
Three difficulties: Normal, Hard, Extreme.
New dashboard UI or classic layout, GPU animation and multilingual menus.
BMW language detection. Play only while parked.
